title: A jointly surjective family of flat morphisms of finite presentation covers every object after an fppf base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms of finite presentation of algebraic stacks admits, for every object over a scheme, an fppf covering of that scheme together with lifts of the object into the members of the family (author lemma at source lines 5912-5922, label lemma-surjective-family-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5924-5934) reduces the family to the single morphism from its coproduct, applies the corresponding criterion for one morphism, and decomposes the resulting covering along the decomposition of a scheme mapping to a coproduct (proof lines 5925-5933). The reduction to the coproduct and the decomposition of the covering are the content. H2.
